changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: CREATE OR REPLACE VIEW reports.vwbillingdebittransaction AS SELECT bdt.id, bdt.transaction_number, bdt.debit_account_id, bdt.patient_id, bdt.encounter_id, bdt.charge_responsibility_id, bdt.charge_id, bdt.charge_line_id, bdt.patient_service_product_id, bdt.payment_id, bdt.payment_transaction_id, bdt.parent_transaction_id, bdt.transaction_type, bdt.amount, bdt.currency, bdt.balance_before, bdt.balance_after, bdt.status, bdt.transaction_date, bdt.due_date, bdt.settled_date, bdt.reference_type, bdt.reference_id, bdt.reference_number, bdt.reason, bdt.approved_by, bdt.approved_date, bdt.idempotency_key, bdt.transaction_group_id, bdt.notes, bdt.created_by, bdt.created_date, bdt.last_modified_by, bdt.last_modified_date FROM public.billing_debit_transaction bdt;

changeSet.author: sondos
changeSet.sql: GRANT USAGE ON SCHEMA reports TO report_user;
GRANT SELECT ON reports.vwbillingdebittransaction TO report_user;

rollback.sql: REVOKE SELECT ON reports.vwbillingdebittransaction FROM report_user;
